text:
Olivia Chen: Taking over the evening shift in ~5. Quick status before I hand off: we have an active P1 (model-serving-latency) that started earlier today. Current mitigation steps: scaled inference pool, rolled back recent runtime change, enabled KV-cache for hot prefixes. Latency improved but 99th is still ~1.1s over target for high-QPS tenants. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-serving-latency

ops-bot: INCIDENT P1 model-serving-latency — pages sent to #pager at 1773453500. Affected: hosted-api (eu-west + us-west), estimated customer impact: intermittent tail latency spikes. Current severity: High.

Dmitri Ivanov: I can take primary drive after handoff at 18:15 PT. I'll be on-call until 02:15 PT. Olivia — can you list the last commands you ran and any non-obvious side-effects?

Olivia Chen: Sure. Last three actions: 1) scaled pool `rsctl scale pool-infer-1 --replicas 24` 2) reverted runtime commit `a9f3b2` (that changed attention kernel) 3) enabled prefix KV-cache on prod for top-50 prefixes. No config changes to routing. No customer-visible regressions reported, just tail.

Lisa Park: I can own comms for the handoff window. I'll keep the status page updated and own customer pings. If you want me as comms owner, I'll draft the message. :+1:

Dmitri Ivanov: Thanks @Lisa Park — that'd be great. I'll drive triage: digging into kernel perf and queue backpressure. If I need infra help I'll ping @oncall infra.

Olivia Chen: Confirming assignments: Driver = Dmitri; Comms = Lisa. Secondary = Olivia (fallback). Escalation: if we cannot hit 99th < 500ms within 45m, page infra pager and SRE lead (pager). Runbook section to follow below.

Olivia Chen: Runbook pointers: 1) Check queue depth `redis-cli -h q-cache.lvl llen model-queue` 2) Inspect kernel perf snapshot: /ops/perf/model-serving/latest (ask infra for access) 3) Temporary mitigation: increase worker concurrency and enable batching delay  -> `rsctl patch pool-infer-1 --set concurrency=8 --set batching_delay_ms=8` 4) Fallback: route specific customers to redundant dedicated endpoint (see runbook step 4).

oncall-rotation-bot: NOTE — shift handoff recorded. Previous primary: Olivia Chen (shift end 1773456789). New primary (starting 1773456900): Dmitri Ivanov.

Lisa Park: Draft for status page (tl;dr): "We are investigating intermittent tail latency spikes affecting hosted inference in EU/US regions. Mitigations applied; engineer is actively investigating. No data loss. Updates every 15m." I'll post in #status and ping impacted customer contacts after the first 15m if no improvement.

Dmitri Ivanov: I'll start with a perf profile across the kernel and check for hot-spoted attention ops. If we see GC/serialization stalls I'll fallback to per-model routing. If anyone notices error-rate spike >0.5% call it out here.

Olivia Chen: One more note — billing/logging team reported an increase in retry traffic from a partner (partner-x). If retries continue, we should consider rate-limiting that tenant at the edge temporarily.

Lisa Park: Got it. I'll add that to the comms message and DM partner-x.

Dmitri Ivanov: Acknowledged. I'll start the perf snapshot now. Olivia, leaving link to my temp debugging container: `ssh -A dmitri@debugbox-3` — I'll post findings here.

Olivia Chen: Thanks team. Handoff complete from my side. I'll stay reachable for 30m if anything unusual pops up. Good luck. :headphones:

ops-bot: Reminder — next automatic escalation will trigger at 1773457120 if incident still active.

Lisa Park: Handoff noted. I'll post initial status update now and follow up every 15.

Dmitri Ivanov: Beginning deep-dive. Will update with timeline and any mitigation commands.

Lisa Park: (later) posted status update and DMed partner-x. No replies yet.

Dmitri Ivanov: (later) initial perf trace shows attention kernel spike on 1 GPU host (infer-14). Marking that host `drain` and routing off it. Running controlled drain: `rsctl drain host/infer-14 --grace 60s`.

Olivia Chen: Thanks — good call. I'll watch logs and help with any fallout.

Lisa Park: Posted second status update: "We identified a degraded host and are draining it; mitigation underway."

Dmitri Ivanov: If drain doesn't normalize tail in 10m we'll consider rolling the model worker on that host.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigations applied: host drain initiated at 1773456898. Next check in 10m.

Lisa Park: Will update customers on resolution progress.

Dmitri Ivanov: Leaving the channel for now to run the drain. Will report back once 99th moves.

Olivia Chen: Thanks all. Handoff complete and tracked.
